candidates.file: Cloudy Bay Cellar Door in Marlborough (4671508402).jpg
candidates.notes: Barrel hall at the Cloudy Bay cellar door, Marlborough (file title/description name it). Shows the cellar-door wine experience; no tasting glasses visible. Landscape 3:2, >=1280. Flickr import, reviewed.

candidates.file: Cloudy Bay Cellar Door in Marlborough (4671506986).jpg
candidates.notes: Second view of same barrel hall (alternate angle).
Cloudy Bay Winery entrance (cellar door building). Only 1024 px wide, BELOW the 1280 why-visit minimum; listed as fallback only.

Titled "Wither Hills, Marlborough, New Zealand, 24 Feb 2007": tawny hills with a lone tree and grazing stock. Shows the hills, not valley vineyards. Wide-ish 1.5, subject near centre. Commons has no usable Wither Hills photo (searched file titles, Wither Hills Farm Park, geosearch).
"Wither Hills Vineyard": vines in foreground with the Wither Hills behind. Weaker than the first because vineyards dominate (the original failure).

spot:blenheim-6.none_reason: Highfield Estate: nothing on Commons, Wikipedia or Openverse (Openverse returns only English "Highfield" suburbs). highfield.co.nz now serves a hijacked gambling page, so the official site cannot be used; try highfield.com or a tourism-board (Destination Marlborough) photo for tier 2, or hold.

candidates.notes: Wikipedia lead image of the Brancott Estate article: vineyard rows seen from the hillside above, Wairau hills behind. Not an aerial (ground/hill vantage) but ultra-wide 3.4:1 so the hero shows only ~28% of width: use the vine fan at centre.

spot:marfells-beach.none_reason: No photo of Marfells Beach on Commons (only katipo spider macros), Openverse or Wikipedia. Nearest Commons file is "Cape Campbell sunrise.jpg" (Phillip Capper, CC BY 2.0, 2984x1964, Cape Campbell and Lake Grassmere salt works) which is a different place about 6 km away, so not proposed. DOC page for Marfells returned 404; a DOC/Marlborough tourism photo would be tier 2.

candidates.notes: Titled "Mountain Bike The Nydia Track, Nelson": bush-covered hill and track-side grass, no people. Plain landscape rather than the bay; the only Nydia-specific free photo found. Look closely before accepting (scenic value modest).

spot:rainbow-ski-area.none_reason: Commons has only botanical files and 2015 NZDF military-exercise photos (AK Q1032139 series, CC BY 2.0, 1800x1198) taken on the Rainbow Ski-field; subject is troops, so not proposed. Openverse nothing. Needs an official photo (rainbow.co.nz did not respond to a scripted fetch) for tier 2.

candidates.file: Mount Eden crater with Auckland CBD and Rangitoto skyline.jpg
candidates.notes: Looking into the crater bowl with the CBD and Rangitoto behind; crater occupies centre-lower frame. 2011, CC BY-SA 3.0.
Summit rim and cone with the city beyond, 6016x4000 CC BY 2.0. Cone is lower-left centre; city skyline dominates the top.
Portrait view down the crater wall with Sky Tower behind; 3264x4896 public domain. Good in a near-square crop (y about 0.65).

candidates.file: Oceanarium tunnel at Kelly Tarlton's Sea Life Aquarium, Auckland, New Zealand.jpg
candidates.notes: Acrylic tunnel with fish, 2022 CC0, 6960x4640. The aquarium itself, though dark and tunnel-like; the file title names Kelly Tarlton's.
Walk-through shark tunnel at Kelly Tarltons, 2008, public domain, 2048x1536; recognisable tunnel with sharks.

candidates.file: Colony of King Penguins at Kelly Tarlton's.jpg
candidates.notes: King penguin colony (Antarctic Encounter), 2012 public domain, 4200x2800. Reads as the penguin exhibit, not the building.
The shark-faced shuttle bus that is Kelly Tarlton's trademark outside the entrance; a vehicle, so a weak fallback (2016, CC BY 2.0).

spot:auckland-9.none_reason: Commons has no good photo of the building exterior (the existing failure); entrance photos are ticket kiosks.

candidates.file: MOTAT Aviation Hall, Auckland, New Zealand.jpg
candidates.notes: Aviation Hall exterior with big MOTAT lettering, 2022 CC0, 4640x3472. Overcast; building and logo recognisable.
Glass-fronted exhibition hall, 2012 CC0 (Reinhard Dietrich), 3648x2736.

candidates.file: Sir Keith Park Memorial Aviation Collection building at MOTAT.JPG
candidates.notes: MOTAT aviation collection building, 2012 CC BY-SA 3.0, 4000x3000; sign visible, rather plain.
MOTAT heritage tram stop and tram, 2022 CC0; shows the museum tramway, more characterful than the sheds.

Anchor Bay beach, Tawharanui (Matakana coast), Hauturu/Little Barrier on horizon; sky, sea and sand. 2848x2136, public domain, 2007. Coast not the village; Tawharanui is part of the Matakana coast but is not Matakana township.
Ascension winery vineyard with bush hills behind, 3648x2736, CC BY-SA 2.0 (2012). Genuinely Matakana wine country but only pleasant, not spectacular.

dest:matakana:header.none_reason: Commons has little for Matakana; no strong township-in-landscape photo exists. Rejected: "Matakana from Bowentown" and "Matakana Island" are a different place (Tauranga).

dest:matakana:why1.none_reason: Matakana Markets.jpg (2013) is the only market photo and is the rejected one (stage, people). Reason is also a weekly event: recommend rewriting why1 around the winery/vineyard (Acension vineyard 3648x2736 CC BY-SA 2.0 usable) or the coast, rather than finding another market photo.

candidates.notes: Titled "Raglan": Karioi ridge across Raglan harbour from the shore. Mountain at left-centre, bay in front; confirm in file page it is Raglan.
Karioi at far left of a 4.7:1 panorama over Whaingaroa Harbour from the south-east; correct mountain but small. Set x about 0.08.
"Mount Karioi covered in cloud" from the Raglan shore; mountain under cloud, less crisp.
Bush track on Karioi itself (2026, CC0, 4032x3024). Shows the mountain's forest, not the profile from Raglan; fallback.
Green karst farmland valley with cattle and limestone outcrops, 2014 CC BY-SA 3.0, 4128x3096 (4:3). Pleasant landscape; no village or cave. Geotagged within ~4 km of Waitomo.
Rolling hills with bush gullies and poplars near Waitomo, same series.

dest:waitomo:header.none_reason: Commons has no spectacular wide Waitomo photo (caves are dark; the entrance canopy is a building). These two are the best landscape fits; judges may prefer to hold.

candidates.notes: TIER 2, PERMISSION RISK: official site banner showing the lily pond, water clock and water-wheel in the garden park; no people close-up. 2500x1200 (2.08:1), centre crop shows the pond and clock. No Commons/Openverse photo exists (Commons hits are Happy Valley/other).
"Die Moepse von Tairua": Ocean Beach at Tairua with Mount Paku behind, surf and sand. Confirm it is the Ocean Beach side from the page. Commons has only Paku/estuary views, no ocean-beach photo.
Kaka inside the sanctuary, 2013 CC BY-SA 3.0, 3528x2344. Shows wildlife (what visitors come for), not the mountain.
Titled "Maungatautari": pasture with the forested mountain behind. Mountain only a low line; weak.

candidates.file: St John's church in Te Awamutu.jpg
candidates.notes: The 1854 St John's Anglican church (Wikipedia lead of Te Awamutu article), 2017 CC BY-SA 4.0, 3558x2801; the town's historic landmark. Confirm spot bio is about the town/heritage.

candidates.file: Tongariro river near National Trout Center (2).jpg
candidates.notes: The Tongariro River beside the trout centre, 2011 CC BY-SA 3.0, 3264x2448 (French description). The river, not the hatchery buildings/ponds; no free photo of the centre itself found (Commons, Openverse). Fallback: "Wild Rainbow Trout entering Taupo Trout Hatchery" is another hatchery.
Titled "Snow on Mt Te Aroha": the summit ridge with the transmitter mast, snow-dusted. Mountain central. Verify it is Te Aroha (Waikato) from the page.
The 115 m Bog Creek suspension bridge on the Timber Trail seen through forest, 2013 CC BY-SA 3.0, 4000x3000; trail icon.

candidates.file: Ongarue spiral Timber Trail interpretation panels.JPG
candidates.notes: Ongarue Spiral on the Timber Trail: trail, trestle bridge, signboard and two cyclists (people minor), 2013, 4000x3000.

candidates.file: Cutting on the Ellis and Burnand Ongarue tramway, now the Timber Trail.JPG
candidates.notes: Characteristic trail stretch with km post, 2013, 4000x3000.
The giant corrugated-iron dog (i-SITE) filling a square frame, 2020 CC BY-SA 4.0, 1600x1601. Best hero crop.

candidates.notes: Dog and sheep buildings together on the street, 3304x2045 CC BY 2.0; both buildings at the edges so use x about 0.5 (shows the sheep building left-centre).
Sheep building (The Merino Story) with the ram, 2020, 1600x1108.
